    c. Construct a second sequence $S_1$ such that:
        i. $S_1(k) = S_0(k)$ for all $k \neq j^*$.
        ii. $S_1(j^*) = 1 - S_0(j^*)$ (i.e., $S_1$ flips the value at $j^*$).
